## 1. Scope and source revisions {#scope}

This comparison follows the specific targets and source revisions below. Use the target list when applying a result to a kernel: a generation label alone does not establish coverage of every processor in that family.

:::: {.reading-block #default-wmma-configuration}

**Default WMMA example:** fragment counts and coordinate examples use **wave32, 16×16×16 dense WMMA, FP16/BF16 inputs, and FP32 accumulation**. The 16-bit packing subsection and sparse-operation rows state their different configurations locally.

::::

AMD’s RDNA documentation index links separate ISA references for RDNA 3, RDNA 3.5, and RDNA 4. This page organizes facts from those manuals and the official programming references. [AMD documentation index](https://rocm.docs.amd.com/en/latest/reference/gpu-arch/rdna.html).

```{=html}
{{< include /rdna-architecture-compare/_tables/architecture-targets-and-source-revisions.html >}}
```

:::: {.note}

The target list defines this page’s scope; it is not an exhaustive family inventory. Product-specific cache capacity, memory bandwidth, clocks, platform/driver support, and GFX12.5 are outside this comparison.
